title: M4 Stage semantics, performance and Evidence trust decisions
goal: Record accepted D20-D26 decisions without changing Stage behavior, CI selection or Evidence authority.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-041 defines versioned Stage roles, Module result kinds and visible dependency execution while preserving wire names and direct runs.
V4-AD-042 requires a measured baseline and coverage-equivalent optimization while retaining supported Windows certification boundaries.
V4-AD-043 limits initial authoritative reuse to policy-accepted trusted-CI Evidence and keeps local Evidence advisory.
V4-TODO-012 remains open for measured cadence review and V4-TODO-022 tracks Stage, timing and Evidence implementation.
No product code, contract, Module, test, workflow, selector, package, consumer repository or remote state changes occur.
risks: Existing uniform Stage behavior could be silently reinterpreted instead of versioned.
Performance optimization could weaken required coverage or hide an aggregate check.
Content-equivalent local Evidence could be mistaken for trusted producer Evidence.
decisions: D20 through D22 accept versioned Stage roles, four result kinds and explicit dependency execution.
D23 accepts measurement-first optimization with representative samples and provisional performance targets.
D24 retains current evidence-based Windows cadence until measurements justify change.
D25 accepts same-run and exact prior trusted-CI reuse initially.
D26 defers managed local attestation while retaining local advisory Evidence.
